text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Why have you activated, 
Princess of Wheels? This is no 
battlefield, but a stage to relish 
blissful boredom, you know?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Lately, I've been researching 
"diving into ST-2 on a daily basis to 
acclimate the body." This is part of that 
endeavor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see... Doctor. I have... a question... 
from before...

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What... do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
......――ST-2 is a robot―― The Professor... 
climbed inside――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
But still. There must be—a will. —In her, 
too—...right?

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. A will... its own will, huh. 
True enough. During maintenance, it really 
does start up at the most unexpected 
times..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Kuku. Bwahahaha!! Insight worthy of a 
master tactician, Kris S!! You truly 
understand the essence of contemplation, 
after all—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"In my view, ST-2 is Sugar Lights. Yet at 
the same time, the vessel is ST-2— and 
within it resides a coexisting soul."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In other wordsâincluding even the third 
life, her. It is all a matter of 
manifestation. That is the Princess of 
Wheels, the tin can, the one and only 
inorganic lifeform!!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, how fascinating. So that's how 
you view ST-2...?"

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
It remains a field yet to be 
scientifically explained, but... Heh. 
Someday, I'd like to prove that it truly 
"exists."
